title: ADDRESS CWA: the common work area (SIT WRKAREA) is one area for the region, shared by the programs of a task and kept for the next task, of any transaction

scenarios.summary: WRKAREA 32: the caller stamps the CWA through ADDRESS CWA, the LINKed callee (no COMMAREA) reads the stamp and writes a reply through its own ADDRESS CWA
a stamp written through ADDRESS CWA by one task (CA0K) is read by the next task, of another transaction (CA0L)
